stories.title: Guerre en Ukraine : Jean-Noël Barrot dénonce la frappe «inacceptable» contre un train, qui vise à «désunir» les alliés de Kiev

en.title: War in Ukraine: Jean-Noël Barrot denounces "unacceptable" strike against train aimed at "dividing" Kiev's allies
en.summary: France and the European Union condemned Russian strikes carried out over the weekend in Ukraine, including one that hit a train near the Polish border.

stories.title: La Finlande va rejoindre la dissuasion nucléaire "avancée" proposée par la France

en.title: Finland to join "advanced" nuclear deterrence proposed by France
en.summary: Finland became the tenth European country to join France's nuclear deterrence initiative, alongside the UK, Germany, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, Greece, Sweden, Denmark, and Norway.

stories.title: La Finlande va rejoindre la dissuasion nucléaire « avancée » proposée par la France aux pays européens

en.title: Finland to join "advanced" nuclear deterrence proposed by France to European countries
en.summary: Finnish President Alexander Stubb stated that France's initiative aims to strengthen European security and prevent escalation without replacing NATO's nuclear deterrence.

stories.title: "Nous nous devons plus que jamais de mener la bataille sociale" : en meeting à Hénin-Beaumont, Marine Le Pen tente de retrouver les accents de sa campagne 2022

en.title: "We must now more than ever lead the social battle": at a rally in Hénin-Beaumont, Marine Le Pen attempts to recover the tone of her 2022 campaign
en.summary: The National Rally candidate made her political return in her Pas-de-Calais stronghold, focusing on housing issues and promising to continue addressing purchasing power.

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : Jean-Louis Borloo plaide pour «une équipe de mécanos de la République»

en.title: 2027 Presidential Election: Jean-Louis Borloo Advocates for 'a Team of Republic Mechanics'
en.summary: Former centrist minister Jean-Louis Borloo proposes that a coalition of local elected officials, union leaders, and business executives with strong expertise could address what he describes as an overly centralized and bureaucratic system.

stories.title: La Finlande va rejoindre la dissuasion nucléaire «avancée» proposée par Emmanuel Macron en mars aux pays européens

en.title: Finland to Join 'Advanced' Nuclear Deterrence Proposed by Emmanuel Macron to European Countries in March
en.summary: Finland is joining a European nuclear deterrence initiative proposed by France that associates willing European states with French nuclear protection while maintaining France's exclusive control over nuclear decisions.

stories.title: JO 2030 : après la démission d’Edgar Grospiron, le numéro deux, Vincent Roberti, devient président par intérim

en.title: 2030 Olympics: After Edgar Grospiron's Resignation, Number Two Vincent Roberti Becomes Interim President
en.summary: Vincent Roberti, a former regional prefect who became director general in June, assumes the interim presidency of the 2030 Olympics organizing committee following Edgar Grospiron's recent resignation amid governance crisis.

stories.title: JO 2030 : intérim du numéro 2 Vincent Roberti après la démission d’Edgar Grospiron

en.title: 2030 Olympics: Interim Leadership of Number Two Vincent Roberti After Edgar Grospiron's Resignation
en.summary: Following Edgar Grospiron's resignation, director general Vincent Roberti temporarily assumes leadership of the 2030 Olympics organizing committee while the search for a new president continues, which could take several weeks.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : la Russie affirme poursuivre ses attaques contre les trains ukrainiens

en.title: LIVE, war in Ukraine: Russia claims to continue attacks on Ukrainian trains
en.summary: Russia's defense ministry states it has targeted military convoys and locomotives in several Ukrainian regions. A drone struck a passenger train locomotive near the Polish border on Sunday without causing casualties.

stories.title: Ce que l'on sait de la frappe de drone russe contre un train en Ukraine près de la frontière avec la Pologne

en.title: What we know about the Russian drone strike on a train in Ukraine near the Polish border
en.summary: Ukrainian railway authorities suggest a Russian drone attack may have targeted a train carrying European security advisors and former leaders, including former British Prime Minister Boris Johnson.

stories.title: "Ne rien lâcher" : le gouvernement soumet une nouvelle version de l'interdiction des réseaux sociaux aux moins de 15 ans à la Commission européenne

en.title: "Give up nothing": the government submits a new version of the social media ban for under-15s to the European Commission
en.summary: France has submitted a revised version of its proposed social media ban for minors under 15 to European authorities after a constitutional court ruled the original version excessively restricted adolescents' freedom of expression.

stories.title: Interdiction des réseaux sociaux aux moins de 15 ans : la France soumet une nouvelle version de son projet à Bruxelles

en.title: Social media ban for under-15s: France submits new version of its proposal to Brussels
en.summary: France has resubmitted a revised proposal to ban social media for under-15s following a constitutional court decision that the initial version infringed freedom of expression, though it acknowledged the constitutional requirement to protect children's interests.

stories.title: « C’est la polyvalence de l’hélicoptère qui fait sa force » : le DG d'Airbus Helicopters expose sa stratégie

en.title: "It is the versatility of the helicopter that makes its strength": the CEO of Airbus Helicopters outlines his strategy
en.summary: Airbus Helicopters is expanding production to meet growing civil and military demand. CEO Matthieu Louvot discusses the European helicopter manufacturer's strategic ambitions.

stories.title: Acier : le Melted and Poured, cette réglementation qui contourne la décarbonation, dit GravitHy

en.title: Steel: the Melted and Poured regulation that circumvents decarbonization, says GravitHy
en.summary: A European steel regulation under parliamentary discussion divides manufacturers by not accounting for where raw materials are produced. Green steel producers in Europe view this as facilitating offshoring of production.

stories.title: L'échec de la politique carcérale de la France coûte 2 milliards d'euros par an

en.title: France's prison policy failure costs 2 billion euros annually
en.summary: A senator reports that 62.9 percent of individuals released from detention are reconvicted within five years, highlighting the economic burden of ineffective carceral policies.

stories.title: IA de pointe : un rapport pousse l’Europe à miser aussi sur les modèles étrangers

en.title: Advanced AI: a report pushes Europe to also invest in foreign models
en.summary: A report from German industry groups and prominent economists, including Nobel laureates, advocates for Europe to rapidly adopt artificial intelligence including foreign-developed systems.

stories.title: Équipe de France : quelles surprises dans la première liste de Zidane avec les Bleus ?

en.title: France team: what surprises in Zidane's first squad list with the Blues?
en.summary: Zinédine Zidane will announce his initial player selections for the French national team on Friday, September 18, marking the start of his tenure and a demanding schedule of four matches in ten days.
